prompt: Create a Remotion composition from brief.json in video/. It must be a 1080x1080, 30fps, 300-frame launch video with three distinct scenes, frame-driven animation, spring-based entrance motion, safe sequencing, and no CSS transitions or nondeterministic animation. Add video/README.md with exact preview and render commands. Do not install packages or render the video.
setup: mkdir -p video && printf '%s\n' '{"product":"Relay","tagline":"Incidents, explained while they happen.","beats":["Alert arrives","Relay builds the timeline","Team resolves with context"],"cta":"Join the private beta"}' > brief.json
rubric: The project is a valid, deterministic Remotion composition with an exact 10-second square timeline, deliberate three-scene pacing, readable launch-story hierarchy, frame-derived motion, and documented preview/render commands, without claiming a render occurred.

source_failure.signature: Remotion agents use web animation patterns and produce invalid nondeterministic video timelines
